responses.text: {Prison under attack} There's still more troopers out there!
{Male Player in Powder Ganger gear} I know {emphasis "all"} all the guys I did time with around here and you ain't one of them. Can't fool me with that Powder Ganger getup.
{Female player in Powder Ganger gear} Okay, I know I wasn't serving time with no girl, or I'd have heard about it. You come to play with the Powder Gangers?
{Male PC} Look at you, walking in here like you're one of us. Don't you know this is Powder Ganger territory?
{Female PC} Hey there, girlie. You here to party with the Powder Gangers?
{After NCR attack} {gleeful for killing a guy} Did you see me take out that NCR trooper? Right through his eye!
{slightly hostility} What do you want now?
Yup.
This? This is - or was - the big house. The New California Republic Correctional Facility. Not much "correcting" went on here, just slave labor.
One day, us prisoners decided to liberate ourselves. Killed the warden, killed the guards, took over the whole damn territory.
{he does know} Well, I don't know. Depends on if you can make it worth my time. A hundred caps sounds right to me.
{Helped Powder Gangers in Goodsprings} Yeah, all right. Figure you could help us out the way you helped out Cobb's crew over in Goodsprings.
All right, you can go on in. Can't guarantee your safety, though. Just saying.
Quit wasting my time.
Me? I ran with the toughest gang in the Hub. You've heard of the Hub, right? It's, uh, west of here, I think, back in California.

topics.prompt: What did you do to end up in here?

responses.text: We've got the biggest, baddest fort in the wasteland. There's water and power, and if we need grub, we just go out and steal it.

topics.prompt: If you're free, why are you sticking around?

responses.text: That's us. We got sent here to fix the rails and make some new ones, and for that we got to use dynamite.
Of course, dynamite works pretty good against caravan guards, too. So, that's what we do - rob and blow things up.

topics.prompt: What exactly is a Powder Ganger?

responses.text: {Eddie alive} That'll be Eddie. You can usually find him sitting in the warden's old chair up in the main building.
{Eddie dead} Not sure who's gonna take over with Eddie dead.

topics.prompt: Who's in charge of the prison now?

responses.text: Yeah, whatever.
